jobs.title: IAM Product Owner – Customer Identity Access Management
jobs.description:
We are looking for an IAM Product Owner to leads the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of enterprise Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) programs. Acts as the product owner responsible for defining vision, prioritizing work, and ensuring delivery of secure, scalable, and seamless customer identity experiences. Partners across business, product, engineering, and security teams to align CIAM capabilities with digital strategy, customer experience goals, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

- Work with key stakeholders to analyze and document requirements, transforming them into actionable functional and technical specifications. Bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility within the CIAM program

- Build a strong CIAM program for customers, partners, suppliers, distributors, vendors and employes and serve as a subject matter expert. Key technical contributor to the strategy, design, engineering and management of the program

- Design CIAM processes and identify opportunities for improvements.  Plan, design and implement key components like user registration/enrollment, authentication/authorization, user self-service, data security, privacy and consent management, fraud and attack detection, session and token management, reporting etc.

- Leading the technical aspects of the CIAM program, providing guidance to team members, and ensuring solutions are aligned with business needs and CIAM best practices

- Work to understand the IT enterprise architecture and collaborate with the architecture team to ensure the CIAM/IAM security standards are created and adopted into the Enterprise Architecture frameworks

- Be the primary point of escalation for operational and security issues for CIAM platform and solution. Lead and support ongoing CIAM operations, maintenance and specific problem resolution. Anticipate, identify, track and assist in resolution of technical issues

- Conduct industry and market research and maintain a working knowledge of emerging trends and technologies in the CIAM discipline. Ensure that the CIAM team is aligning with global standards and initiatives

- Create and manage a training program to develop the CIAM team. Develop and increase the capability and skills of the current team. Identify, staff, and manage necessary skills to fill gaps in the team

- Manage and direct a consultative team approach for enterprise-wide security initiatives with key stakeholders

- Produce & review daily, weekly, monthly reports to measure services against key performance & risk indicators

- Create an environment of trust and confidence amongst the team
Nice to Have
- Experience with Salesforce ecosystem (Experience Cloud, Apex, LWC)
- Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud)
- Familiarity with Active Directory and hybrid identity models
- Preferred position relevant information security certifications (CISSP, CIGE, CIAM, CIMP, CAMS, CIPA)
Competencies
- Strategic & Innovative Thinking (CIAM product vision and roadmap)
- Driving Effective Outcomes (product delivery and measurable impact)
- Engaging with Impact (cross-functional alignment and influence)
- Ensuring Customer Success (frictionless, secure digital identity experiences)
- Security & Compliance Principles (privacy-first CIAM design)
- Manages People & Teams (building high-performing product teams)
- Directs Work (clear backlog prioritization and execution discipline)

Education, Licenses, Certifications
- College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required.
- Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Security Essentials Certification, GIAC Security Leadership Certification, Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) Certified Information Security Manager, Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer: Security, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification preferred.
- This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with 12+ years of information security or information technology experience
- 10+ years’ working experience in Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM)
- Strong understanding of CIAM concepts, technologies, and best practices. Highly effective in developing and communicating audience appropriate information to technical, non-technical, management, and executive audiences
- Proven experience in successfully designing, implementing and operating CIAM service capabilities and overall IAM functions in technically complex organizations
- Extensive experience in  architecting,   building and implementing  large-scale  CIAM platforms with one or more of the leading CIAM/AM products - MS Entra External ID, Ping Identity, Okta, Salesforce IAM etc.
- Experience in developing and running multi-year, complex CIAM initiatives and programs
- Experience managing relationships with Product and Services vendors. Proven ability to build and maintain strong enterprise relationships with internal and external teams/partners
- S trong understanding of AM protocols (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) and security principles, including encryption, token security, and session management.
- Deep knowledge of agile processes and workflows
- Must have good communication and collaboration skills
- Solid diagnostic, testing, and problem-solving skills
- Experience with Lightning Pages, triggers, SOQL, SOSL, API, Flows, LWC, Web Services (SOAP & REST)
- Proficiency in data manipulation and analysis using SQL. Experience with Angular framework/Java.
- Working knowledge of Active Directory concepts, including users, computers, groups, policies. Experience with Linux and Windows Operating Systems
- Understanding of database architecture and concepts
- Good organizational and time management skills
- Must be team-oriented and able to collaborate across many participating teams
Responsible for leading the execution and delivery of cybersecurity engineering initiatives that safeguard the organization’s critical business operations, information systems, and data. This role oversees the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of security tools, architectures, and processes while ensuring alignment with organizational policies, industry frameworks, and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: IT Product Manager - Supply Chain EWM
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Defines the product vision, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and market trends; Leads the end-to-end lifecycle of a complex, high-impact product. Drives business outcomes and continuous improvement leveraging financial insights, team metrics, KPIs and inspiring teams to achieve excellence. Accountable for maximizing product value. Act as the voice of the customer in planning sessions and related events.

Key Responsibilities:

Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap; lead the teams in delivering solutions oriented around business impact ensuring it supports business goals and representing the voice of the customer. Conducts market research, user interviews, and data analysis to inform product decisions, define personas and their pain points ensuring these insights inform product requirements and solution development. Technical understanding of the scope of enabler work; Collaborates with Enterprise and Solution Architect/Engineering to assist decisions and sequencing of technology enablers. Shape product backlog with clearly defined and prioritized user stories, defects, enablers and acceptance criteria, ensuring ongoing alignment with evolving business priorities and stakeholder expectations. Accepts user stories as done, including validation of the stories meeting acceptance criteria; has appropriate acceptance tests, and complies with the Definition of Done (DoD). Drive user acceptance testing and ensure features meet business and quality standards before release. Partner with the Scrum Master/s and Agile Coach/s to drive continuous improvement. In partnership with InfoSec / legal teams, ensure that systems meet company standards for security, compliance and data privacy. Participate in release planning, sprint planning and demos with stakeholders; Actively participate in PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events as the voice of the customer. Define and track key team performance metrics, KPIs and objectives and key results (OKRs) to ensure alignment with strategic goals. Work closely with business owners and other stakeholders to define product goals, success metrics, roadmap and establish the products’ business value, support messaging, communication and customer outreach as necessary. Financially responsible for the product – ensures the product investments are successful throughout product lifecycle. Responsible for people management including work plan development, performance management, and people development. Responsible for team building and development including organization structure, recruiting, team management.

Business process fit - Develop, drive and champion innovative ideas and strive to achieve business fit, optimizing user journeys, and leveraging continuous research and data on business trends to adapt and thrive in dynamic environments. Product/Service launch - Lead a launch plan; collaborate with other teams (e.g., business partners, legal/compliance) for effective product growth and adoption, tracking user feedback and aligning stakeholders on a launch strategy. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Agentic AI Framework
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Technical Product Manager - Agentic AI Framework to join our team specializing in Systems/Information Technology for our Corporate organization in Columbus, IN.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

- Act as the voice of the customer by deeply understanding customer needs, personas, and user problems, ensuring solutions deliver real market and business value.

- Translate customer insights, user research, and market trends into compelling problem statements that guide product strategy and solution design.

- Collaborate with Epic Owners to develop Lean business cases for Epics, aligning investments with value delivery across the Agile Release Train (ART).

- Apply portfolio and program‑level strategy by aligning product decisions with strategic themes, the Portfolio Canvas, Lean Budgets, and Guardrails.

- Own and manage the Program Backlog and Kanban flow, ensuring features are prioritized, transparent, well‑defined, and continuously ready for execution.

- Lead Program Increment (PI) planning by presenting product vision, approving PI objectives, assigning business value, and determining release timing based on delivered value.

- Partner with System and Solution Architecture to understand enablers, influence sequencing decisions, and balance technical and business priorities.

- Build and lead a strong Product Management/Product Owner team while fostering trusted relationships across the organization to consistently deliver business outcomes.
Job Summary
Drives the strategy, development, and adoption of the IT Agentic AI Framework - a foundational platform enabling teams across the IT organization to design, build, and deploy intelligent software agents at scale. The ideal candidate bridges the evolving agentic AI landscape and strategic enterprise IT goals, translating complex multi-agent architectures into governed, reusable capabilities that accelerate solution delivery.
Key Responsibilities
- Own the product roadmap for the Agentic AI Framework, prioritizing orchestration capabilities, agent library governance, and developer enablement across agent teams and solution builders
- Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering teams, solution architects, and business stakeholders on agent design patterns, MCP-based tool integration, orchestration best practices, and context management strategies
- Define and own the enterprise orchestration strategy, establishing standard patterns for sequential, parallel, hierarchical, and event-driven multi-agent workflows adopted across the organization
- Govern the selection, configuration, and evolution of the core orchestration engine - evaluating frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent SaaS offerings) against enterprise scalability, reliability, and governance requirements
- Define and govern the enterprise agent library - overseeing intake, versioning, approval workflows, and lifecycle management of reusable agents, tools, and MCP server endpoints
- Partner with AI architects, security, and compliance teams to embed TRiSM standards into the framework - including explainability, behavioral guardrails, prompt injection defense, and AI risk governance
- Lead enablement for internal agent teams, solution advisors, and domain developers adopting the framework, ensuring teams build confidently on shared infrastructure
- Track the agentic AI ecosystem - emerging standards (MCP, A2A, OpenTelemetry for agents), open-source frameworks, and vendor capabilities - and translate findings into actionable roadmap recommendations
- Define requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for framework deliverables in alignment with the AI Center of Excellence

Competencies:
- Agentic Orchestration Expertise: Deep working knowledge of multi-agent coordination patterns - supervisor/worker, peer-to-peer, fan-out/aggregation, ReAct, and plan-and-execute - and  the ability to prescribe the right pattern for enterprise use cases
- Orchestration Platform Fluency: Hands-on familiarity with orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Temporal, or equivalent), durable execution models, state management, and workflow failure recovery patterns
- Agentic AI Alignment: Translates business goals into framework capabilities - orchestration patterns, solution accelerators, and reusable agent components that reduce time-to-value
- Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of orchestration frameworks, MCP protocol, RAG architectures, LLM gateway patterns, agent memory management, and multi-agent coordination
- AI Governance & TRiSM: Embeds trust, risk, security, and privacy controls by design - guardrails, audit logging, agent cards, and anomaly detection
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Operates effectively across AI engineering, enterprise architecture, security, data governance, and business solution teams
- Innovation Awareness: Maintains current knowledge of the agentic AI ecosystem and proactively shapes the framework roadmap as standards and tooling evolve
- Balances Stakeholders | Customer Focus | Global Perspective | Values Differences

Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience
- Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field
- 4-6 years in product management, platform engineering, or technical program management - minimum 2 years in AI, ML, or enterprise software platforms
- Hands-on with agentic AI concepts: LLM tool-calling, multi-agent orchestration, MCP, RAG, and agent memory patterns
- Strong communicator - able to translate complex agentic architecture for both engineering teams and executive audiences
To be successful in this role you will need the following:

- Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

- Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

- Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

- Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

- Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

- Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

- Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.

- Building High Performance Teams - Identifies and applies critical skills and Lean-Agile principles and practices in the creation of high-performing Agile teams to construct high-quality, well designed technical solutions.

- Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.

- Lean Portfolio Management, budgets, and Economic Framework - Applies Lean and systems thinking approaches in support of strategy, investment funding, Agile portfolio operations, and governance; evaluates working systems; manages Epic investments and dynamic budget adjustments to minimize overhead through funding and empowering Value Streams while maintaining financial and fit-for-use governance to minimize overhead; assesses and supports decision rules that align to the financial objectives of the Solution to guide the economic decision-making process.

- Planning and Managing Ceremonies - Plans, schedules, and leads ceremonies that create a cadence for the team to maximize productivity, promote collaboration, maintain transparency, and inspect and adapt so the team can continuously learn and improve.

- Program Backlog Management and User Story Elaboration - Identifies, refines, prioritizes, and sequences backlog items using Weighted Shortest Job First (WSJF) to ensure the economic success of the solution; determines the details of a product feature to ensure that any unanswered questions about it are answered so that development can proceed.

- Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
- College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required.
- SAFe® Product Owner/Agile Product Manager (POPM) or SAFe® Agile Product and Solution Management certifications are preferred.
- This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
- Significant business and technical knowledge with practical experience of the Lean methodology, principles and tools are preferred.
- Experience working in an Agile Environment is preferred.
- Significant experience as a Product Owner is preferred.
Content authority for the Program Backlog. Responsible for identifying customer needs and product market trends, prioritizing Features, guiding the work through the Program Kanban in support of business agility and developing the program vision and roadmap for an Agile Release Train (ART). Works closely with development, in short, integrated learning cycles, to bring the voice of the customer to the developers and the voice of development to the customer, and to maximize the value of multiple products resulting from the work of the product/agile team.

jobs.title: Placement Student - Product Marketing
jobs.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Product Marketing Student to join our team specializing in Product Marketing for our Europe aftermarket team in Redditch, UK . During your placement with us, you will learn how a major global organization operates, gaining the tools and exposure you will need to become an expert in the industry.
This role is available to candidates who qualify for a placement year and will commence 2027 .
The requirements are to be onsite for 3 days per week so you will need to be able to travel or relocate to the location on your own behalf.
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:
- Research the European aftermarket to identify key competitors, potential suppliers.
- Evaluate market size, market shares and size the opportunities for Meritor or Euclid branded product lines.
- Identify product line needs, products ranges, market drove features and differentiators.
- Develop and present product strategy and product roadmap.
- Propose product selling proposition including price positioning.
- Define product requirements and specifications to launch internal programs in accordance with customer needs and product roadmap.
- Ensure alignment of the global product plans.
Closing date: Thursday, 12 th November 2026, 11:59 PM
To be successful in this role you will need the following:
- Working towards Degree in Product Development and/or Marketing, Product Management or Business Studies.
- MS office and IT skills are essential in this role.
- In this role, you will need to use a lot of your methodical skills, research skills, attention to detail and good communication skills (written & verbal).
- Ability to manage multiple projects.
